text: １１かいに　いる　ボスに　れんらく　しなくては！

structure.jp: １１かいに　いる　ボスに
structure.en: to the boss who is on the 11th floor

structure.jp: れんらく　しなくては！

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.span: れんらく　しなくては
patterns.explanation: しなくては is short for しなくてはならない, 'it won't do if I don't', which means 'must'. The ending is left unsaid. れんらく　しなくては = 'I have to get in touch'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a person describes that person. １１かいに　いる　ボス = 'the boss who is on the 11th floor'.
